text: Installed verified ARM64 Temurin 21.0.12.1+1 and sbt 1.13.0 launcher, configured user JAVA_HOME/PATH, prepared exact provider artifacts. Kept the sbt 1.11.7 project pin after a matched sbt 1.11.7/1.13.0/Mill 1.1.10 experiment: all 45 timed commands succeeded and all three builds passed 301 HRF tests per platform. Mill faster at unchanged checks but slower at edits/clean compile/tests. The full checkout passed compile-all without warnings under the 1.13.0 trial and HRF JVM/JS tests again under the final 1.11.7 pin. Reproducible runner, measured data, compressed logs, hashes and migration complexity assessment are in tools/build/mill-spike and docs/benchmarks/build-tools-20261005.md. No production build migration; no full-suite or scientific/native qualification claim. Changes remain uncommitted.
